How often do you find yourself walking an alpaca🦙through a magical, snow-capped forest in the Arctic Circle, feeling like you’ve wandered straight into Narnia?

Everywhere I looked, there was nothing but white — trees wrapped in thick snow, the quiet crunch beneath my boots, and the softest little alpaca walking beside me as if it had always belonged in this fairytale. The air was icy, the forest completely silent, and time felt like it had slowed down just enough for me to take it all in.

There are moments in life that are beautiful… and then there are moments that feel almost unreal.
This was one of them❄️

📍Lapland, Finland 🇫🇮 

@visitlapland @visitfinlandia

Unlike any other hike I’ve ever done.

What started as a casual “let’s go see a waterfall”
turned into a four-hour hike through snow-covered mountains in -25°C.

Layers on layers of clothes.
Restricted movement.
Freezing hands.
Frozen nose. 🥶

Even taking photos and videos felt like a challenge…
but somehow I managed.

And the waterfall I came to see?
Not one. Not two. FOUR waterfalls — all completely frozen. ❄️

In the middle of all that snow, we even stopped for a BBQ and warm traditional berry juice — which tasted extra yum in that cold. 😋

Cold. Tough. Magical.
And absolutely worth every step🏔️

Lapland you are just fantastic 👍🏻

Finland → Brussels → Paris → Dubai

This wasn’t part of the plan—four days stranded in Europe during a war. But what happened next restored my faith in leadership and humanity.

First and foremost, my deepest gratitude to God, my Mahadev🔱for protecting us and guiding us safely back home. I truly feel blessed🕉️

The past few days were a reminder of how unpredictable life can be. Being stranded in Europe during such uncertain times was never something we imagined. All we wanted was to get back home to our children♥️

My deepest gratitude to Emirates @emirates 
The crew, the ground staff, the pilots—every single person handled the situation with such calm, professionalism, and kindness. In the middle of a tense time when even the skies felt uncertain, they made us feel safe and cared for. The journey back to Dubai was smooth, reassuring, and something I will always be grateful for.

And separately, immense respect and pride for the leadership of the United Arab Emirates. @hhshkmohd @faz3 @united_arab.emirates_ 

The decision to organize repatriation flights for stranded residents—including expats like us—speaks volumes about the kind of country this is. 
A place that truly looks after everyone who calls it home.🇦🇪

Moments like these remind you why we choose to build our lives here.
Grateful to be back home… and to finally hug our children after four long days🧿

We watched the sky change colors 💚💗💜🤍
emerald into blush, violet into pearl —
like the universe itself was celebrating us👩‍❤️‍👨

Countless memories🔱
One timeless love🧿

To the man who turns dreams into destinations —
and checks off my ultimate bucket list:
happy anniversary, my love🌌✨🔱♥️
